# Marguru: code map

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Describe your business and get copy-ready AI prompts for ads, Google Maps, SEO, content and reporting, in the order an ad agency would do the work.
**Live:** https://marguru.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/marguru · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `marguru/.claude/skills/marguru/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py marguru` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Playbook content lives in `theme/assets/mg.js`** (window.MG: TYPES/REACH/GOALS..., STAGES, PROMPTS with `when(v)`/`text(v)`, TIPS, EXAMPLE), moved unchanged from the JS version. Its facts are source-checked: never edit a prompt, tip or number without a primary source. Python reaches it only through `client_code/mg.py` (JSON text in/out via `MG.json`), so pages get plain dicts. Prompt ids are keys of saved progress and stats: never rename one.
- **Field guide data** (INVOICE, FLAGS, WORDS, SOURCES) is `client_code/guide_data.py`, verbatim from the JS version; static guide/landing copy is in the templates.
- **Browser storage keeps the JS version's keys** (`marguru.guestPlan`, `marguru.stage.<plan|kind>`, `marguru.math`, `marguru.theme`): read/write with `mg.store_get/store_set` (real dicts; `UI.store.get` returns JS proxies).
- **Plan page** (`Pages/Plan`): three sources (server plan, guest plan, built-in example). Each `Items/PromptCard` gets `{p, host}` and calls `host.progress()/persist()/track()/step_done()`; cards redraw themselves (`draw`) so the keyboard keeps its place. The brief chip: the shared `v.brief` must stay inside each `text(v)` unchanged.
- **Router extras**: `#plan/<id>` sends visitors to sign-in (and back after); `#plan/local` with no guest plan goes to `#build`. Visitors also get the nav and a phone tab bar (Try it, Field guide, Ad math, Wins, Sign in): `router.nav_links/tab_links`.
- **Desk** moves a guest plan into the account once (`save_plan(profile, None, progress)`), then clears it.
- Design: the notebook look (cream paper, 1.5px ink outlines, hard offset shadows, dotted paper, highlighter `<mark>`) is the brand and is marked `design-ok`; eyebrow labels were folded into headings/leads in the conversion.
- Smoke test: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (tools/ui/smoke.js: signed out incl. a guest plan, a new member, admin; 1280 + 390 px).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **app_settings**: key:str, value:obj · used in common
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **plans**: owner→users, name:str, profile:obj, progress:obj, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Plans
- **prompt_stats**: prompt_id:str, copies:num, last_copied:dt · used in Stats
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in Admin, DemoData
- **wins**: author→users, business_type:str, channel:str, title:str, story:str, result:str, created:dt, clappers:obj, hidden:bool, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Plans, Wins

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
